entities.summary:
Yemen is a sovereign nation in West Asia, Asia. Its capital is Sana'a (Houthi-controlled, disputed); Aden (government-claimed temporary capital). Official languages include Arabic. Government: Unitary presidential republic (de jure); effectively divided between Houthi-controlled north (Sana'a) and internationally recognized government (Aden/Riyadh-based) since 2014.

Population: approximately 34.4 million. Area: 455,000 km². historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Yemen's ancient Saba civilization was a major center of frankincense/myrrh trade, while its Islamic conquest in the 630s had significant regional implications. The country's modern civil war (2014-2022) resulted in over 377,000 civilian deaths and widespread humanitarian crisis.
